_what: Old trillion's sign-in pages at 4ffa1dc4a2^ (src/pages.mjs, drawn by src/html-page.mjs through parts/ui/show/server-rendered-page/page-sections-html.mjs): each page's description as src/pages.mjs handed it to htmlPage, and the HTML the old shell wrote for it. The look's pieces, the same on every page, are written once as {{name}} in `html` and pinned by the SHA-256 of the old bytes in `pieces`. src/account/sign_in/shell_tests.rs draws every description through shell.rs in the product's look and checks it byte for byte.

description.title: Create your Trillion account
description.meta_description: Sign in to Trillion or create your account, and bring the AI you already use to find the needle mover and get it done.

sections.heading: Create your Trillion account
sections.body: If your setup requires access to a beta app, Trillion may arrange its invitation through the app provider using your verified account email. Trillion HQ sees what you do here, like which screens you open, which tools run and any errors, so we can fix things for you. We never see what you write unless you allow it. You can change this any time in Settings, under Privacy.

sections.heading: Check your email
sections.body: Enter the 6-digit code we sent. It works for 10 minutes.
